thread:
trevor: Hey team, CI on master is red — 3 failing tests in storage/postgres integration after the llvm 15->16 bump merged in PR #4821. last-green 1762980000. can someone bisect? :thinking_face:
ci-bot: job: storage-postgres-integ (linux-gpu) failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345 — console snippet: 'ERROR: libllvm.so undefined symbol...'. Failing tests: TestPGConnectionPool, TestIndexRebuild, TestKVDurability
anna: copying logs, seems a runtime symbol error in dynamic load. maybe the build uses system llvm vs bundled. attaching quick grep: `nm -D libredwood.so | grep LLVM`
sophie: i'll start a local bisect this afternoon. can you post the suspected range? last green commit is 26f8a2c, HEAD is 9d1c4b7.
trevor: range: 26f8a2c..9d1c4b7. suspected culprits: @leo landed the llvm upgrade in 9d1c4b7 and @marcus touched linker flags in 8b3e99a.
leo: i'm around — the upgrade PR changed the Docker base image and build matrix. didn't touch runtime dtors. happy to help with bisect but if it's a packaging mismatch we might revert the base image quickly.
sophie: running git bisect now. command I'm using:
```
git bisect start 9d1c4b7 26f8a2c
# test script
./dev/ci/run_postgres_integ.sh || git bisect bad
```
will update in ~30m.
deploy-bot: rerun queued: /ci rerun storage-postgres-integ #12345 triggered by @sophie
anna: quick check — we had a flaky failure last month on TestKVDurability due to randomized ordering, but the symbol error is consistent. if bisect points to packaging, recommend revert base image and redeploy.
sophie: bisect update: first bad at 8b3e99a (linker flags) — verifying with rebuilt image. looks like 8b3e99a introduces -Wl,--as-needed change.
trevor: thanks. @leo @marcus can you review 8b3e99a? if confirmed, we should revert it on master to restore CI and then follow up with a non-breaking fix.
leo: yes that's me. i can open an emergency revert PR now.
marcus: looking — the flag was to reduce binary size but I missed the effect with dynamic llvm symbols. will revert and push a fix. sorry about that :grimace: 
trevor: great. once revert PR is up, @ci-bot please run the full matrix. mark priority high.
ci-bot: noted. i'll watch for PR #4829 (revert) and trigger tests automatically.
